LESSON: INVERTEBRATES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 1.2: Invertebrates

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Invertebrates. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are the common features of invertebrates?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify common invertebrates in the environment
2. practise precautions in handling invertebrates
3. describe the general characteristics of invertebrates
4. appreciate the importance of invertebrates in nature
5. identify main parts of the human circulatory system
6. describe functions of main parts of the human circulatory system

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: INVERTEBRATES
This lesson teaches Invertebrates for Grade 6 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify common invertebrates in the environment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. practise precautions in handling invertebrates
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. describe the general characteristics of invertebrates
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. appreciate the importance of invertebrates in nature
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
5. identify main parts of the human circulatory system
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
6. describe functions of main parts of the human circulatory system
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Invertebrates using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Invertebrates above.
2. Explain Invertebrates to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Invertebrates.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Invertebrates with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Invertebrates important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the common features of invertebrates?
2. What is the human circulatory system made up of?
3. What measures enhance a healthy human circulatory system?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify common invertebrates in the environment
2. practise precautions in handling invertebrates
3. describe the general characteristics of invertebrates
4. appreciate the importance of invertebrates in nature

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
